#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds ./app: a launcher that runs the server with Node.js.
# The server has no third-party dependencies, so nothing needs fetching.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "build.sh: node is required" >&2; exit 1; }
node --check src/server.js
node --check src/main.js

cat > app <<'LAUNCHER'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
exec node "$DIR/src/main.js" "$@"
LAUNCHER
chmod +x app

{
  "name": "kvhttp",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "In-memory HTTP/1.1 key-value server",
  "type": "module",
  "main": "src/server.js",
  "bin": { "kvhttp": "src/main.js" },
  "engines": { "node": ">=20" },
  "scripts": { "start": "node src/main.js", "test": "node check.mjs" },
  "private": true,
  "license": "MIT"
}
